prompt: Write a short email from Piero, an MFE student at UC Berkeley, to his professor, Ali Kakhbod. Points to cover: Piero and his teammates Romain and Elias chose the LLM watermarking paper for their fall project; they would like 20 minutes on Zoom this week to go over their plan; Thursday or Friday works for them. Write it like a real student writing quickly: plain and polite, two or three sentences, no exclamation marks, no subject line, no 'I hope this email finds you well', no 'looking forward'. Start with 'Hi Professor Kakhbod,' and end with 'Thanks,' and 'Piero' on separate lines.
